scientific_integrity: The proof is symbolic over the complex numbers; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification, Jacobian reduction, and formal transverse A1 models concern only the open subset where all cycle-edge entries are nonzero. Lower-dimensional boundary components and special boundary singularities are not classified. Finite calculations supplement but do not prove the all-size theorem. A possible unindexed earlier specialization in symmetric periodic Jacobi operator or minimum-rank literature remains an originality risk.
title: Grassmannian reconstruction and uniform nodal germs of cyclic Jacobi determinant hypersurfaces
